report.scene_summary: The video shows a manufacturing floor with a large blue mechanical press on the left and a material handling area on the right. A worker is seated at the press, leaning into the machine's point of operation for an extended period. A large coil of metal is stored on a pallet in the center of the floor, adjacent to a marked yellow aisle. A worker is seen walking on a marked green pedestrian path on the right side.

findings.title: Worker Exposure to Press Point of Operation
findings.location: Left side of the scene, at the blue mechanical press
findings.observation: A worker is seated on a stool directly in front of the press, leaning forward with their head and hands inside the machine's point of operation. This position is maintained throughout the video sequence. The machine appears to be stationary or in a setup phase, but the worker is encroaching on the danger zone.
findings.risk_interpretation: The worker is exposed to potential crushing or entanglement hazards if the machine were to activate unexpectedly. This is a critical guarding violation.
findings.applicability_reason: The worker is in the danger zone of a mechanical power press. The energy state is unknown; if the machine is active, it is a direct violation. If it is being serviced or set up, Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) procedures should be verified.
unknowns: Presence of a physical point-of-operation guard
Whether LOTO procedures are in effect
recommended_actions: Verify the machine's energy state immediately.
Ensure the worker is not reaching into the danger zone while the machine is active.
Confirm that appropriate point-of-operation guarding is installed and functional.
If servicing is occurring, verify that Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) procedures are followed.

findings.title: Material Storage Obstructing Aisle
findings.location: Center of the floor, adjacent to the yellow painted aisle line
findings.observation: A large coil of metal on a wooden pallet is stored on the floor. The pallet and coil are positioned immediately adjacent to a yellow painted line, which marks an aisle or walkway. The material appears to be encroaching on the marked path.
findings.risk_interpretation: The stored material obstructs the marked aisle, creating a trip hazard and potentially blocking the path for material handling equipment or emergency egress.
findings.applicability_reason: The material is stored in a manner that creates a hazard by obstructing a marked aisle/walkway.
unknowns: Intended clearance width of the marked aisle
Whether the coil is intended to be stored there permanently or temporarily
recommended_actions: Move the coil and pallet completely outside the yellow painted boundary.
Designate a specific storage area for materials and ensure aisles remain clear.

dismissed.reason: The worker's eyewear is not clearly visible in the provided crops. Cannot confirm if safety glasses are being worn. No visible eye hazard (e.g., flying debris) is confirmed in the static frames.
A circular object is visible on the floor near the aisle. Its identity (e.g., rubber mat, metal ring) is uncertain. It does not appear to be a spill or a significant obstruction.

limitations: No reliable floor-like mask found; static-zone ranking uses general scene candidates.
